description: List source and place coverage for inspections, violations, pipeline cases/decisions or certificates. Includes the API's measured freshness, completeness and caveats where available. Counts have source-specific meanings; complaints are separate from violations. Requires sign-in. Licensing has no coverage endpoint.

name.description: Optional place-name substring, filtered locally before pagination

pipeline_dataset.description: Only for dataset=pipeline: cases, decisions or all (default)

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

name: get_dataset_coverage
title: Dataset coverage
